card.name: Concentration units after a strength number
card.fires_on: The unit sign right after a concentration number, mainly "/mL" after mg and "%" after a number. It appears in solution strengths, such as "10% solution" or "5 mg/mL".

modes.label: Per-mL strength
modes.description: The "/mL" part of a mg/mL strength in dilution or preparation steps.
modes.example: Prepare a stock solution (100 mL of 0.8 mg<</mL>> tedizolid phosphate)

modes.label: Percent strength
modes.description: The percent sign after a number naming a solution or topical strength.
modes.example: A single intravenous administration of 20 mL of 10<<%>> sodium thiosulfate

card.plain: It marks the unit that finishes a solution strength, like the /mL in 5 mg/mL or the % in 10%.
